faqs.q: When can I view a property?
faqs.a: Viewings are available Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00. Video viewings can be arranged any day.

faqs.q: Do buyers pay an agency fee?
faqs.a: No. Buyers pay no agency fee to Demo Coast Properties; the commission is paid by the seller.
Our team speaks English, Spanish, German, Dutch, Swedish and French.
Our office is in Marbella. Viewings start from the property itself, or we can collect you from your hotel in Marbella.

faqs.q: How quickly will an agent contact me?
faqs.a: Laura or a colleague will contact you within one working day.
